ambient_events: Your shoulders scrape brick on both sides at once.
A pipe overhead ticks as something cools — or moves — inside it.
Grit sifts down from the low ceiling and finds your collar.
description: A maintenance crawlway barely wide enough to pass, its ceiling a tangle of sweating conduit and dead cable. Someone bolted a walkway over the channel here a lifetime ago; half of it has rusted through into the flow below. It runs south to a dead-end alcove and north back to the junction.
name: Maintenance Crawl
